findings: pig-profile.origin renders Dam, Sire and three ear tags in the sans face: the host sets mono only for labels starting 'Ear tag|Tag|ID'.

findings.text: The main pig profile is not on Facts: pig-profile.full 'General details' and 'Sow cycle' are hand-built grids (.overview-details-grid / .overview-fact) in a panel, same job and look. General details also prints 'Health —' under a banner that says 'Health · Thin', so the screen says health twice and disagrees.
findings.fix: Render both blocks with SentriUI.facts (Weight and Temperature trails as meta) and drop the Health row; the banner owns health.

findings.text: IDs are not mono in use: pig-profile.origin shows 000118, B-024, 000267, S-000267, M-267 in Plus Jakarta Sans because inspection-astra-concept.js:970 sets mono by the label regex /^(Ear tag|Tag|ID)/.
findings.fix: Set mono from the field (dam, sire, every ear tag, breeding number), not from the label text.

findings.text: The Death breakdown sheet (farrowing-astra-concept.js:423) is a hand-built dl with raw CSS (#f6f7f2, 9px/14px) for read-only label and value pairs. It is one surface in a sheet, not card-on-card, so it is Facts' job.
findings.fix: Draw it with SentriUI.facts (one fact per cause plus 'Total dead'); no panel-less Facts variant is needed.

findings.text: columns:1 is still in bundle.js with no screen.
findings.fix: Remove the mode; a long value wraps in two-column.

findings.text: The two links below facts read differently: piglet 'Weigh the litter: growth figures need it. ›' (an amber sentence with a full stop) vs farrowing 'Death breakdown ›' (an ink label).
findings.fix: Make the piglet link a text Button label ('Weigh the litter ›'); if the reason stays, put it in the Litter weight fact's meta.

proposals.name: Farrowing total triplets into TaskMetrics / TaskTotals, not Facts
proposals.why: The builder was right to leave them out of Facts: Born · Alive now · Piglet deaths and 7 · 2 · 9 are headline figures inside a metrics card or progress panel, and Facts would put a panel in a panel. Their hand-built dl copies (.task-performance-totals inside task-death-review, .finish-totals) should come from TaskMetrics totals and TaskTotals instead.
